records.text: Jessica Ghawi was present at a Toronto mass shooting and died in another mass shooting a few weeks later.
records.speaker: Baron Coleman

appearances.snippet: Jessica Ghawi was in that food court. she paid her bill at like i don't remember 6 20 or something like that and three minutes later the shooting started but in those three minutes she said she had a really weird feeling in her stomach decided she didn't want to be around and she walked out and i thought that's weird um she has this premonition that something bad's going to happen then a mall gets shot up And then a few weeks later, she dies in a mass shooting.

verification.notes: Jessica Ghawi's own contemporaneous account and the Congressional Record establish that she left Toronto's Eaton Centre shortly before the June 2012 shooting and was killed in the Aurora theater shooting the following month.

sources.title: Late Night Thoughts on the Eaton Center Shooting — Jessica Redfield
sources.relevance: Ghawi's contemporaneous first-person account says she left the Eaton Centre food court moments before the Toronto shooting.

sources.title: Congressional Record, July 26, 2012
sources.relevance: Records Ghawi's escape from the Toronto shooting and her death in the Aurora theater shooting weeks later.
